pairs.original: When you first left me, I was wanting more
pairs.simlish: Wona bileptou wawawa pua mu u u

pairs.original: But you were f***** that girl next door
What ya do that for? (What ya do that for?)
When you first left me, I didn't know what to say
I've never been on my own that way
Just sat by myself all day
I was so lost back then
But with a little help from my friends
I found a light in the tunnel at the end
pairs.simlish: A fu nili pae ni tu ni ava uens

pairs.original: Now you're calling me up on the phone

It's only because you're feeling alone

Yeah, it makes me smile, yeah, it makes me smile

But then I just smile I go ahead and smile
